spec.name: aoe4guides API
spec.description:
The public REST API for [aoe4guides.com](https://aoe4guides.com) — programmatic, read-only access to community-created **Age of Empires IV** build orders.

Fetch build orders in the full schema or the compact **overlay** format used by in-game build-order tools, filter by civilization or author, and sort by score, recency, views or likes.

**Good to know**
- Open and read-only — no authentication or API key required.
- Each list endpoint returns at most 10 results; there is no pagination yet.
- Civilizations use 3-letter codes (e.g. `ENG`, `FRE`, `JIN`); see the `Civilization` schema for the full list.

**Fair use**

This API is free, unauthenticated, and paid for out of one person's pocket. It stays that way as long as people use it in proportion to what they actually need. Concretely:

- **Please don't enumerate the whole corpus.** The list endpoints return 10 results and exist for browsing and filtering — not as a paging mechanism for walking every build order on the site. Bulk crawling is where the cost lands: in one measured month, list calls accounted for roughly 44k of the ~48k Firestore document reads the service served.
- **If you need bulk data, come talk to me first.** I would far rather hand you what you need than have it reconstructed one filter combination at a time — it is cheaper for me and better data for you. Reach me at info (at) aoe4guides (dot) com or on [Discord](https://discord.gg/Nau9BN5E7J).
- **Respect the cache.** Responses are cached briefly and may be up to 60s (lists) or 5min (single builds) old. Please honour `Cache-Control` rather than re-fetching the same build per page view.
- **Rate limits per IP.** 30/min and 300/hour for list endpoints, 120/min and 1200/hour for `/builds/{buildId}`. Exceeding them returns `429`; the `RateLimit` response headers tell you where you stand. They sit an order of magnitude above what real integrations use — if yours genuinely needs more, ask rather than working around them.
- **Credit _and_ link back.** Labelling the data as coming from aoe4guides.com is the minimum. A working link to [aoe4guides.com](https://aoe4guides.com) beside it is what sends people back to the community that wrote these build orders, which is the only thing that keeps them being written. Logos and colours: [aoe4guides.com/brand](https://aoe4guides.com/brand).

None of this is enforced beyond the rate limits, and I would like to keep it that way.
